package service

import (
	"context"

	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"

	pb "github.com/acme/bookings/gen/acme/bookings/v1"
)

// CheckAvailability returns the rooms with no reservation overlapping [check_in, check_out).
func (s *Server) CheckAvailability(ctx context.Context, req *pb.CheckAvailabilityRequest) (*pb.CheckAvailabilityResponse, error) {
	in, out := req.GetCheckIn(), req.GetCheckOut()
	if in == nil || out == nil || !out.AsTime().After(in.AsTime()) {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "check_out: must be after check_in")
	}
	busy := map[string]bool{}
	for after := ""; ; {
		page, err := s.store.ListReservations(ctx, after, 500)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, s.toStatus(ctx, err)
		}
		for _, r := range page {
			if r.GetCheckIn().AsTime().Before(out.AsTime()) && in.AsTime().Before(r.GetCheckOut().AsTime()) {
				busy[r.GetRoomId()] = true
			}
		}
		if len(page) < 500 {
			break
		}
		after = page[len(page)-1].GetId()
	}
	var free []*pb.Room
	for after := ""; ; {
		page, err := s.store.ListRooms(ctx, after, 500)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, s.toStatus(ctx, err)
		}
		for _, room := range page {
			if !busy[room.GetId()] {
				free = append(free, room)
			}
		}
		if len(page) < 500 {
			break
		}
		after = page[len(page)-1].GetId()
	}
	return &pb.CheckAvailabilityResponse{Rooms: free}, nil
}
